title: Finch Circle Long-Standing Membership Credit on Alteration Quotes (Marlowe & Finch Alterations)
content:
A membership tenure credit is taken off the honored amount of a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket for a long-standing membership in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program:

| Active Finch Circle membership, enrolled before today by | Tenure credit taken off the honored amount |
|---|---|
| 120 or more whole months | 2.00 USD |
| 60 to 119 whole months | 1.00 USD |
| fewer than 60 whole months, or no active membership | none |

**Record read.** The enrolment date of the customer's active Finch Circle membership, counted in whole months up to today; a month counts only once complete.

## Thresholds, both sides

| Whole months enrolled | Credit |
|---|---|
| 59 | none |
| 60 | 1.00 USD |
| 119 | 1.00 USD |
| 120 | 2.00 USD |

## Hypothetical illustration

A member enrolled 15 years ago (180 whole months) has 2.00 USD taken off the honored amount; a member enrolled 6 years ago (72 whole months), 1.00 USD; a member enrolled 3 years ago, nothing.
